name: Sarasa Crain Femiluna
original_name: サラサ・クレイン・フェミルナ
source:
Likes: Umeboshi (pickled plums), basking in the sun

[url=/c7211]Arisa's[/url] sickly younger sister who, like her, is from France and a mix between American, Japanese and British. Because of her illness, she is forced to stay in the hospital,  and Arisa often comes to visit her. Like her older sister, she is very calm. Sarasa loves books, especially romance books, to the point where she can remember most of them word-to-word. She deeply respects Japan's culture, and due to this, she likes umeboshi a lot.
